session.name: MPI-383 - crop past the image edge (canvas extension, snapping, exact-resolution mode)

key_decisions: Fill for the new area is a colour from MpiColorPicker (same primitive as the Resize pad and Remove Background), not transparency and not hardcoded black - user decision. That flat colour is the outpaint target
NO auto-mask over the extended area - user decision: prompting the model to fill the coloured area beats handing it a painted mask
RESOLUTION is the ONLY family that resamples - user decision. RATIO and FREE always output the selected pixels untouched
Snapping has no bypass modifier: a sub-8px border is exactly what the feature exists to prevent
Ratio-locked snapping adjusts the SCALE, never one edge, so the ratio is never broken
Video and App cropping (js/utils/cropTool.js, normalized 0-1) deliberately untouched in v1 - ffmpeg crops and cannot pad
constraints: SHARP: .extend is applied AFTER extraction whatever the call order. extend and extract MUST be two passes with a toBuffer between, or Sharp throws 'extract_area: bad extract area'. Cost a debug cycle already

MpiCanvas exposes core methods through an ALLOWLIST (const _methods in MpiCanvas.js). A method missing there is undefined on el and the caller dies far from this file - it silently half-mounted the crop panel (no Apply button)
The crop panel CSS sets `display: flex` on its sections, which BEATS the UA [hidden] rule. Any section hidden with el.hidden needs its own [hidden] CSS rule

The managed view must NOT refit while a crop drag is live - scale is what maps cursor to image space, so changing it mid-gesture makes the rect chase the pointer. It settles on mouseup (InputController calls onDraw there)
Crop geometry can only be drawn on screenUICanvas - overlayCanvas is sized to image-native pixels
A ratio alone cannot restore an exact-size box: re-entering crop mode re-fits the largest CENTRED box for that ratio. That is why the viewer keeps _activeCropSize
The working tree has concurrent uncommitted work from other agents/cards - never `git add -A`
